notablePrerequisites:
Journey to Eternity attached to Palimchron.
You must control six lands which can produce 4BG.
description:
Sacrifice Palinchron to Carrion Feeder.
Return Palinchron to the battlefield, and return Journey to Eternity transformed into Atzal, Cave of Eternity.
Untap lands sufficient to produce 4BG.
Produce 4BG without activating Atzal.
Sacrifice Palinchron to Carrion Feeder.
Activate Atzal's second ability, targeting Palinchron.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, untap Atzal and other lands sufficient to produce 4BG.
Produce 4BG without activating Atzal.
Repeat.

uses.name: Journey to Eternity // Atzal, Cave of Eternity
